subject.title: feat: expose resolved backend model in session_status and agent runtime

question: What canonical contract should OpenClaw expose for selected, effective, and actual upstream model identity across session rows, session_status, and runtime metadata?
rationale: The issue crosses Gateway wire API shape, persisted session metadata, provider fallback semantics, and user-visible status wording, while existing fields already carry related but ambiguous runtime state.

options.title: Add explicit resolved-runtime fields
options.body: Additive resolvedProvider/resolvedModel/fallbackUsed-style fields preserve existing selected-model behavior while exposing the actual backend identity consistently.

options.title: Clarify existing model fields only
options.body: Treat modelProvider/model as effective runtime identity and update status text/docs without adding a new Gateway contract.

options.title: Split observability by consumer
options.body: Keep backend/proxy identity in provider diagnostics and leave UI/status fixes to narrower linked issues.

recommendation.title: Add explicit resolved-runtime fields
recommendation.body: Additive resolvedProvider/resolvedModel/fallbackUsed-style fields preserve existing selected-model behavior while exposing the actual backend identity consistently.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the clearest recent history touching gateway protocol and embedded runner surfaces involved in the contract boundary.
